The complete goal retains a real chemical experimental demonstration. Casee practical8points require observed PPE/stock/label/pipetting/control actions. Basic contextual safe laboratory performance is a genuine prerequisite for that whole experimental operator, although paper cases do not themselves require execution. This adds no teacher/learner trial as a machine-release gate.

rejectedAlternatives.why: Whole P universally requires redox half-equation construction, electron balancing and Al/Ca transfer, which equilibrium materials do not universally need. Do not swap one overbroad full admission for another.

Formula literacy is useful in chemical examples, but all equations/species assignments are supplied and abstract A⇌B uses symbols directly. No independent full molecular-formula-generation gate is added.

findings.preserved: All titles/descriptions/P cases, laboratory/evidence limits and image bytes stay exact. Esterformation remains a separately learned goal and unchanged contextual example.

findings.finding: Full independent constitutional-isomer drawing/comparison is not a necessary universal entry gate.

foundationJustification.why: Use already-existing common interaction model as foundation: dispersion in all molecules, permanent dipoles, hydrogen-bond donors/acceptors, structure/size and nonuniversal ranking. Full P uses supplied ethanol/ether and acetone/hexane structures/data, not drawing isomers. Ion-dipole is a coherent wider vocabulary component of this existing basic model; this is not a claim every91cdcase examines ions. Already an old transitive prerequisite via e9→345→536→5a302→eb753, so no new whole subject duty is introduced.

rejectedAlternatives.why: Full P adds melting/packing/solvent-choice tasks beyond the particular polar-property application. Use the underlying interaction vocabulary directly.

Bond/molecule polarity is useful underlying knowledge but does not itself supply the hydrogen-bond/dispersion/solvation interaction model used by both current cases. No further full surface-representation gate is added.

findings.preserved: Constitutional-isomer competence remains independently available and source-backed; no removal from authored topic scope. No description/profile/image or card changes.

scienceVersusMechanics: Only after this frozen necessity decision measure current actual view/course availability and DAG. Availability does not select the chemistry foundations. No application or new independent vote.
